release_read.basis: Record Q3 revenue $73.4m against a ~$66m permit-covered guide/consensus (+11%) and non-GAAP EPS $0.41 against Nasdaq's $0.30 forecast, 56% gross margin; smaller overshoot than Q2's +40% (+28.7% reaction), and no Q4 guide in the release, so sized just under the 12.4% implied move.

release.released_at_note: 8-K exhibit dated 2026-10-29, after the close; exact minute not read, call 13:30 PT
release.headline: AXT Inc. Announces Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results (record revenue $73.4 million)

key_line.metric: Q3 revenue vs permit-covered guide; Q4 guide
key_line.detail: Revenue beat the permit-only guide by ~11% (vs +40% last quarter). The release carries no Q4 revenue/EPS guide; export permits listed only as a risk factor. The Q4 guide (consensus already at stated capacity per the hunt) would have come on the call and was not verified.

guidance.detail: No Q4 guidance in the press release; any guide given on the call was not verified in time.

call.detail: Call held last night at 13:30 PT; content not verified in the time available. The after-hours fall to -6.9% despite a clean beat suggests the Q4 guide or permit commentary on the call disappointed against a consensus already at capacity.

public_reaction.summary: Not searched: time budget (compile 09:24) spent on the release. Broad tape weak: QQQ -2.6%, SPY -1.0% pre-market.

tape_read.note: Robust reference 56.42 (-7.3% vs 60.88 close) against a +10% release read: the market is pricing something the release does not show (likely the Q4 guide / capacity cap on the call) plus a -2.6% QQQ. Pre-market active (176 prints, 26 in last 30m, last 09:19, not stale); range 55.70-60.71 with after-hours at 56.70, so the drop has held all night. Position is -9.3% from entry 61.99.

thesis_check.note: The permit-covered guide was beaten as the thesis said, but by far less than last quarter, and the Q4 brake the judges named (consensus at capacity) appears to be what the market is trading.

expected.open_lag_note: Active, non-stale pre-market that has held -7% since last night's after-hours, so the open should hold it; earnings gaps tend to give back about a point by 10:00, but a -2.6% QQQ is a headwind to that fade.

recommendation.reason: De cijfers waren goed (omzet en winst boven verwachting), maar het aandeel staat voorbeurs ruim 7% lager, waarschijnlijk door een tegenvallende vooruitblik in de call en een zwakke techbeurs. De positie staat verlies; koersdalingen na cijfers herstellen vaak een deel in het eerste halfuur, dus verkoop om 10:00 in plaats van op de opening.
recommendation.what_would_change_it: Als de voorbeurskoers voor 09:30 verder wegzakt onder 55,70 of de Nasdaq-futures nog verder dalen, dan direct op de opening verkopen.
